records.name: Sargento Nochunterwegs
records.biography_en: Can rally a whole corridor without finding the correct exit. His whistle rallies HyperNorm residents into a corridor that no map admits exists. A dissonant card points to an ordinary unlocked exit. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Sammlung ist gelungen. Der Ausgang fehlt.

variant_notes.note_en: Can rally a whole corridor without finding the correct exit.

records.name: Enlace Umweg
records.biography_en: Carries urgent news that changes while she is carrying it. Her satchel carries a HyperNorm message whose urgency survives every change of meaning. A dissonant card adds a personal address. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Eilig ist vorerst nur die Beförderung.

variant_notes.note_en: Carries urgent news that changes while she is carrying it.

records.name: Infante Nochhier
records.biography_en: Holds his position until someone explains which position they mean. His blanket roll contains the permission to leave a HyperNorm position he was never formally assigned. A dissonant card notices the discrepancy. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Stellung wurde gehalten. Ihr Zweck blieb aus.

variant_notes.note_en: Holds his position until someone explains which position they mean.

records.name: Mecánica Buenarueda
records.biography_en: Fixes the transport and refuses to fix the official explanation. Her spanner keeps HyperNorm transport running while policy classifies the fault as imaginary. A dissonant card keeps the broken washer. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Reparatur widerspricht dem mängelfreien Zustand.

variant_notes.note_en: Fixes the transport and refuses to fix the official explanation.

records.name: Oficial Vielleichtdoch
records.biography_en: Has a clear view of everything except his next decision. His binoculars find every HyperNorm problem at a safe explanatory distance. A dissonant card insists on looking through the other end. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Überblick wird durch Nähe beeinträchtigt.

variant_notes.note_en: Has a clear view of everything except his next decision.

records.name: Camillero Sachtjetzt
records.biography_en: Believes recovery starts when everybody stops giving advice. His bandage roll is for HyperNorm residents told their pain is merely a difference of opinion. A dissonant card sits with them. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Genesung beginnt nach Ende der Ratschläge.

variant_notes.note_en: Believes recovery starts when everybody stops giving advice.
